test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electronic Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following 'V' blocks will have one 'V' groove and two grooves (slots) on either side for clamping in two positions?

options.text: Single level double groove V block

solution:
The description given is:

 
• 
 
**One ‘V’ groove**

 
 
• 
 
**Two grooves (slots) on either side**

 
 
• 
 
Used for **clamping in two different positions**

 

This construction corresponds to a **single level double groove V-block**.

 
• 
 
It has **one V-groove** on the top surface to support cylindrical workpieces.

 
 
• 
 
It has **two side slots/grooves**, allowing the work to be **clamped in two positions**.
